comment: Every sentence the film shows, already broken into lines, one string per line on screen. The one source for the storyboard document and for the app. `labels` gives the small label over a plate of a caption kind (a kind without one has no label); `accents` gives the colour of the bar beside such a plate, as a palette key (default: signal). `sections` has one entry for each group of kind `section` in shots.json, joined on `group`; `n` and `name` must equal those of the group. The keys of `lines` are the caption kinds of the section.

name: A Better
Cup
line: to a good cup of tea

hook: Leave the leaves in too long
